text:
jenna_billing: FYI got a DM from NebulaWorks — their Feb invoice shows a ~15% overage vs committed capacity after an APAC failover. They want a breakdown and a goodwill credit. attaching vendor email inline.

maria_finance: can you drop the invoice id + meter lines? need to see whether failover was charged to burst or to reserved pool.

jenna_billing: INV-NEB-2026-02 attached. key excerpt from vendor: 'we triggered cross-region failover for 3h on 2026-02-12; charges spike in ap-southeast unexpectedly as burst usage'.

sam_ops: quick check — our failover routing should attribute traffic to the customers reserved nodepool when capacity exists, otherwise to shared burst. looks like this incident had reserved capacity in eu-west but not in ap-southeast, so fallback hit burst.

alex_prod: do we have the policy logs for that window? iirc we had a short graceful fallback rule that should have preferred reserved dedicated failover within same tenant if any pool tagged 'global-failover'.

sam_ops: pasted raw meter lines from the infra pipeline (sanitized):
```
metering: customer=nebulaworks request_id=abc123 region=ap-southeast model=gpt-4-mini tokens=350000 bucket=burst timestamp=2026-02-12T03:16:05Z
metering: customer=nebulaworks request_id=abc124 region=eu-west model=gpt-4-mini tokens=1250000 bucket=reserved timestamp=2026-02-12T02:10:01Z
metering: customer=nebulaworks request_id=abc125 region=ap-southeast model=gpt-4-mini tokens=200000 bucket=burst timestamp=2026-02-12T04:05:12Z
```

sam_ops: so ~550k tokens in ap-southeast charged as burst. that matches the vendor's delta.

maria_finance: thanks. what triggered failover? was that customer-initiated or platform autoscaling/maintenance?

sam_ops: platform autoscaling + network flap in eu-west — traffic re-routed. tenant has reserved commit scoped to eu-west only, not multi-region. failover didn't reassign reserved tokens cross-region. i'll open a short ticket to ops-runbook to evaluate cross-region reserved mapping.

tim_sales: NebulaWorks is on an enterprise contract; they expect predictable failover behavior. theyre asking for a one-time goodwill adjustment while we sort the policy.

maria_finance: propose provisional credit for the burst portion during the failover window: credit = burst_tokens * unit_price (we'll calc). do we have approval to apply as goodwill (no SLA hit) vs formal SLA credit?

jenna_billing: they asked for an SLA credit explicitly in the email but sounded open to a one-time adjustment. i can offer provisional credit pending ops' root cause.

alex_prod: +1 on provisional credit while we confirm. also recommend we add a flag to mark failover-typed events so they don't auto-bill as burst while under investigation.

maria_finance: requesting approval from finance lead: @david_cfo can we issue provisional goodwill credit up to $3k (est based on preliminary math) while ops confirms whether this meets SLA credit criteria? :thinking:


david_cfo: ok to approve provisional credit up to $3k provided we log the decision and attach the final RCA. please include exact token counts and unit rates in the memo.

jenna_billing: noted. i'll draft credit memo and reply to NebulaWorks asking for 48h while we investigate. cc @tim_sales. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: created ticket OPS-6123 to investigate cross-region reserved mapping and to add the failover billing flag. ETA 72h.

maria_finance: once invoice memo is ready share with me and i'll generate the credit memo. also flag product to consider a docs update re: reserved scope vs failover.

tim_sales: i'll own the customer comms after jenna drops the initial hold note. want to keep it high-trust.

jenna_billing: draft message i'm going to send to NebulaWorks: "Thanks — were investigating an unexpected failover billing spike on 2026-02-12. We will issue a provisional credit for the affected burst usage within 48h while we complete an RCA. Details and final resolution to follow." ok?

maria_finance: looks good, include the provisional credit amount in USD and add 'subject to final RCA'.

jenna_billing: will do. pulling meter export and cost calc now, will post final numbers in this thread.

metering-bot: export ready: s3://redwood-metering/exports/nebulaworks/2026-02-12/1778888888-export.csv

jenna_billing: thanks. posting numbers: burst tokens charged during window = 550000, unit cost = $0.005/token => provisional credit = $2,750.

maria_finance: approved. process credit. david_cfo: will log final sign-off after ops RCA.

david_cfo: noted. keep me posted.

jenna_billing: credit processed and memo sent to NebulaWorks. closing until RCA complete. :white_check_mark:
